prompts.pushinka:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D game sprite turnaround and separate wing layers.
Image 1 is the approved character identity, do not redesign it. Generate ONLY this same character from additional viewpoints, matching its shape, large irregular honey-crystal facets, palette, stripes, brown antennae with polygonal ball tips, tiny stubby feet, face and intrinsic decorations exactly. No crown or added clothes. Four feet in two pairs, hidden feet may be occluded. Compact integrated head-and-abdomen, NEVER separate head/thorax/abdomen, never pear or egg. Match the original body width/height. Same warm upper-left light.
CRITICAL OUTPUT LAYOUT: transparent square PNG sprite sheet, exact 2 columns by 3 rows of equal square cells, no text, no grid, no shadows outside sprites. Six isolated sprites, each centered in its cell with 15% margin, NOTHING touching cell edges.
Cell row1 col1: front-facing body, WITHOUT WINGS. Row1 col2: strict right-facing side/profile body, WITHOUT WINGS.
Cell row2 col1: rear three-quarter body looking away toward right (135 degrees from front), WITHOUT WINGS, no face visible. Row2 col2: direct back body, WITHOUT WINGS, no face.
Cell row3 col1: one isolated LEFT wing cutout, broad pale polygonal translucent wing matching the original, root at its rightmost lower edge. Row3 col2: one isolated RIGHT wing cutout, root at its leftmost lower edge. No body with the wings.
All four bodies equal height including antennae; all directions same object and stripe count. Keep species decorations attached in 3D-consistent place, they may be occluded on the back. Whole body rendered with believable volume and facet shading, clean silhouettes. Actual transparent background required.
Character identity details: Cream-colored bee with a cream faceted fluffy ruff across the lower face, caramel brown belly stripes, warm ivory wings.
